## Functions

### `i2c_base_scan_bus`

_Source: `lib/i2c/i2c_base.h`_

```cpp
int32_t i2c_base_scan_bus(uint8_t *found_devices, uint32_t max_devices, TickType_t timeout);
```

Scan I2C bus for connected slave devices

| Parameter | Description |
|---|---|
| `found_devices` | Array to store addresses of found devices |
| `max_devices` | Maximum number of devices to detect |
| `timeout` | Timeout for each I2C operation |

**Returns:** Number of devices found, or error code if negative
